content.text: Fine, I'll just refuse the delivery.

You can refuse the package when it arrives; the carrier will return it to us. Once we receive the returned chair (and it’s within 30 days of the delivery attempt), we’ll process a full refund for you.

Let me know if you’d like any further assistance.

Customer wants to refuse delivery. That's effectively a return/refund after delivery. We can explain that they can refuse, and after it's returned we can process a refund if within 30 days. Since not delivered yet, we can note that once it's returned we can refund. No tool needed.
